say:2:1522201001:0.text: Hey! You blind? Everyone's lining up. Get to the back!
say:2:1522201001:0.source_cn: 喂，没看到大家都在排队吗？到后面去！

say:3:1522201002:0.text: I don't have time to stand around.

say:4:1522201003:0.text: This is relief food! It's for people trying to survive! What makes you rich folk think you deserve it?
say:4:1522201003:0.source_cn: ……这是赈灾粮，是救命的粮食！你们有钱人凭什么来领？！

say:5:1522201004:0.text: Pfft. You think you're the only one who's lost something?
say:5:1522201004:0.source_cn: 哼，呼临城里谁没受灾啊？

say:6:1522201005:0.text: If it's relief food, it ought to go to everyone. You don't get to just take it all for yourselves.
say:6:1522201005:0.source_cn: 既然是赈灾粮，那就人人有份。凭什么让你们独占？

say:7:1522201006:0.text: Are you kidding me? Look around, half the city's waiting on this food to stay alive!
say:7:1522201006:0.source_cn: 什么歪理！你没看见，这么多人都等着这口救命的粮食吗？

say:9:1522201007:1.text: That's enough! Everybody back in line!

say:10:1522201008:1.text: Oh, now you speak up? Where were you when he shoved his way to the front? Send him to the back!
say:10:1522201008:1.source_cn: 他刚才大摇大摆插队的时候你怎么不说？你让他排到最后去！

say:12:1522201009:0.text: Kalan again. Can't even keep order during a food handout.
say:12:1522201009:0.source_cn: 又是卡利安那个没用的家伙，连这点破事都管不住！

say:15:1522201011:0.text: Uh-oh, this is about to get good...

say:0:1522202001:0.text: If there's shouting at the food line, it's not just about hunger.
say:0:1522202001:0.source_cn: 赈灾点发生骚乱，恐怕不会是因为小事。
say:0:1522202001:0.male: If there's shouting at the food line, it's not just about hunger.
say:0:1522202001:0.female: If there's shouting at the food line, it's not just about hunger.

say:2:1522203001:1.text: You can't do this... Your life's already better than ours. Why are you fighting us for the little food we've got left?
say:2:1522203001:1.source_cn: 你们不能这样……你们的生活已经比很多人都好了，为什么还...

say:3:1522203002:0.text: It's just not... *Cough*... it's not right...

say:4:1522203003:0.text: Not right? It's not my fault you're poor!
say:4:1522203003:0.source_cn: 有什么公不公平的？你们没钱又不是我的错！

say:5:1522203004:1.text: We've all been starving. What, you think we're hoarding bread in secret?
say:5:1522203004:1.source_cn: 饥荒这么久，你们没东西，难道我们就有吗？整个呼临城谁没受灾？

say:6:1522203005:0.text: But you... *Cough*... you can still buy food! We can't!
say:6:1522203005:0.source_cn: 但是你们……咳……你们不缺粮食！你们有钱买啊……！

say:7:1522203006:0.text: Buy? With what? My farm's dried up, thanks to the drought, I've got nothing to harvest, and I'm buried in debt!
say:7:1522203006:0.source_cn: 谁说我有钱了？呼临城和整片高原都干旱，我家的农田一点收...

say:9:1522203007:0.text: Then explain those clothes. Look at us. Look at you!
say:9:1522203007:0.source_cn: 你看看你穿的是什么，我们穿的是什么！

say:10:1522203008:0.text: If that's what "poor" looks like, then I—

say:12:1522203009:0.text: That's enough! All of you, quiet!

say:15:1522203011:0.text: Sir, it's... someone cut in line. The others didn't take it well...
say:15:1522203011:0.source_cn: 报告副将，是……是有人插队，其他人有所不满……

say:16:1522203012:0.text: You useless fool. Can't even manage a food line. Ten written reports on my desk by tomorrow!
say:16:1522203012:0.source_cn: 丢人现眼的蠢货，发放赈灾粮这点差事你都干不好，回去写十...

say:17:1522203013:0.text: And the rest of you, form a line! No yelling, no grabbing. If I see another fight, no one gets fed!
say:17:1522203013:0.source_cn: 至于你们，全都给我站成一列，不许争抢，不然粮食不予发放！

say:19:1522203014:1.text: It's not just about lines anymore! Why's someone like him getting relief food at all?!
say:19:1522203014:1.source_cn: 现在已经不是插队的问题了！是他这种有钱人凭什么来领赈灾粮！

say:20:1522203015:0.text: You're the lieutenant, right? <style="highlight">Perseus' right hand</style>? Then do something! You can't just let this slide!

say:22:1522203016:0.text: Do what, exactly? Hand-deliver all the food to your front door?
say:22:1522203016:0.source_cn: 还要怎么给你们做主？难不成要把所有赈灾粮都运到你家里去？

say:24:1522203018:0.text: Didn't you hear the lieutenant? Get in line, or get nothing.
say:24:1522203018:0.source_cn: 没听到副将刚才说的吗？赶紧排好队，要不然就没粮食了。

say:25:1522203019:0.text: You bastard... Forget the food. I'm gonna teach you a lesson!
say:25:1522203019:0.source_cn: 你这个混蛋……我今天不要粮食了，就要打你一顿！

say:1:1522205001:0.text: Anyone lays a hand on anyone else and I swear, you'll answer to the army!
say:1:1522205001:0.source_cn: 谁敢动手？！真当军队都是摆设吗！

say:2:1522205002:0.text: The relief food is for <style="highlight">every Halian</style>. Rich or poor. That's the law!

say:3:1522205003:0.text: Keep making trouble, and I'll have you locked up!
say:3:1522205003:0.source_cn: 要是谁再闹事，就等着被我关进牢里去！

say:6:1522205004:1.text: That food is saving lives! You can't do this!
say:6:1522205004:1.source_cn: ——那些是救命的粮食！你怎么能这么做？！

say:7:1522205005:0.text: Move it, move it! Didn't you hear the lieutenant?!
say:7:1522205005:0.source_cn: 去去去！没听到副将大人都发话了吗？

say:8:1522205006:0.text: You want to keep shouting? Then you can shout from a jail cell!
say:8:1522205006:0.source_cn: 你要是再闹事，就等着被投牢吧！

say:10:1522205007:0.text: Haha... Didn't think I'd see something this funny today.
say:10:1522205007:0.source_cn: 哈哈……没想到还有这么好笑的事。

say:11:1522205008:0.text: Tell me, did you let Perseus in on your little scheme? Or are you planning to <style="highlight">rob the relief food</style> behind his back?
say:11:1522205008:0.source_cn: 我很好奇，你们商量好的事告诉珀尔修斯了吗？他知道你们<...

say:12:1522205009:0.text: You... what are you implying?! W-watch your mouth!
say:12:1522205009:0.source_cn: 你……你这话几个意思？！我、我警告你，不要血口喷人！

say:14:1522205010:1.text: He's not wrong. Perseus will hear about this. And he will punish you.
say:14:1522205010:1.source_cn: 他没有说错。珀尔修斯会惩罚你们。

say:18:1522205014:0.text: Lieutenant Lygos, drought might be eased by a lucky rainstorm, but famine like won't be fixed overnight.
say:18:1522205014:0.source_cn: 隆尔副将，干旱尚可盼望一场大雨缓解，但呼临城的饥荒绝非...

say:19:1522205015:0.text: With limited food reserves, it's my view that <style="highlight">priority should be given to those suffering the worst</style>. It's the fastest way to save lives.
say:19:1522205015:0.source_cn: 在存粮有限的境况下，以我拙见，<style=highl...

say:21:1522205017:0.source_cn: ……这是呼临城的事，不用你费心。

say:23:1522205018:0.text: Kalan, give the food to the starving. People like Jakon don't get a crumb.
say:23:1522205018:0.source_cn: 卡利安，把粮食分给那些饥民，不许伊阿宋这样的家伙领。

say:26:1522205021:0.text: And you! Why are you standing around? Start handing out the food!
say:26:1522205021:0.source_cn: 还有你！杵在这里发什么愣？还不快去发粮食！

say:31:1522205013:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a guest under Perseus' protection. You know full well you won't go against his orders.
say:31:1522205013:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a guest under Perseus' protection. You know full well you won't go against his orders.
say:31:1522205013:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a guest under Perseus' protection. You know full well you won't go against his orders.

choice:16:2:3.text: Shut up or I'll make you!
choice:16:2:3.source_cn: 你再多说一句我就先揍你
choice:16:2:3.male: Shut up or I'll make you!
choice:16:2:3.female: Shut up or I'll make you!

say:4:1522207002:0.text: Colluding with rich folk to steal relief food... Hard to believe a lieutenant of Perseus would stoop so low.
say:4:1522207002:0.source_cn: 和有钱人勾结抢赈灾粮……真想不到珀尔修斯的副将居然会做...

say:5:1522207003:0.text: Halia's more rotten than I thought.
say:5:1522207003:0.source_cn: 看来呼临城里的污糟事也不少。

say:6:1522207004:1.text: We don't know the full story yet. Let's not jump to conclusions. Lygos may have reasons of his own.
say:6:1522207004:1.source_cn: 事情的全貌尚未明了，我们不能妄下定论。或许隆尔副将有自...

say:7:1522207005:1.text: Since he told us to wait here, we might as well <style="highlight">talk to the people nearby</style>, see what's really going on in the city.
say:7:1522207005:1.source_cn: 既然他让我们在此等候，不妨趁此<style=highl...

choice:2:2:3.text: I still like the Wildborn better!
choice:2:2:3.source_cn: 还是雅库伯尔人更讨我喜欢！
choice:2:2:3.male: I still like the Wildborn better!
choice:2:2:3.female: I still like the Wildborn better!

say:0:1522208001:0.text: We can ask the people in line, or the soldiers handing out food.
say:0:1522208001:0.source_cn: 我们可以向这些饥民和发放粮食的士兵询问。
say:0:1522208001:0.male: We can ask the people in line, or the soldiers handing out food.
say:0:1522208001:0.female: We can ask the people in line, or the soldiers handing out food.

say:1:1522209001:0.text: Y-you're with the lieutenant, right? I-I'm not slacking! I'm doing my job!
say:1:1522209001:0.source_cn: 你们是跟着副将的那些人……我、我没有偷懒！我在认真发粮食！

say:3:1522209002:0.text: Relax. We're just curious about how the relief food is being handled.
say:3:1522209002:0.source_cn: 不必紧张，我们只是好奇赈灾粮的发放情况。

say:4:1522209003:0.text: But you brought a Wildborn with you... I can't say anything.
say:4:1522209003:0.source_cn: 但是你们还带着一个兽人……我不能说。

say:9:1522209005:0.text: We're only asking about the food situation. Nothing military.
say:9:1522209005:0.source_cn: 我们询问的只是赈灾粮的情况，绝非呼临城的军事机密。

say:10:1522209006:1.text: I swear on the name of the Arcane Council, none of this info would change anything on the battlefield, even if the Wildborn's army heard every word.
say:10:1522209006:1.source_cn: 我以魔法师协会的品格担保，即使这些信息流向战场，传入雅...

say:11:1522209007:0.text:
The Arcane Council...
You're that mage who visits the city often, aren't you?
say:11:1522209007:0.source_cn: 魔法师协会……\n你就是那个经常来城里的魔法师？

say:13:1522209009:0.text: Heard you've healed a lot of folks here... Alright, guess it's no secret.
say:13:1522209009:0.source_cn: 我听说你给不少人都治过病……好吧，反正也没什么机密。

say:14:1522209010:0.text: Ever since the drought and the famine hit, <style="highlight">the city's food has only gotten scarcer</style>. Especially after the troops marched out to fight the Wildborn, most of our reserves went with them.

say:15:1522209011:1.text: At first, the relief came often enough. But with the war dragging on, we can't keep up like before...
say:15:1522209011:1.source_cn: 最开始赈灾粮发放得还算频繁。但战争一直没结束，我们已经...

say:16:1522209012:0.text: This one wasn't even planned—it came because the Regulus gave the order himself.
say:16:1522209012:0.source_cn: 就拿这次来说吧。这次的赈灾粮是领主特意下令，在原本的计...

say:17:1522209013:0.text: I heard the council was against it at first, but <style="highlight">General Perseus overruled them and made it happen</style>.
say:17:1522209013:0.source_cn: 据说议事官们起初都不同意，<style=highlig...

say:19:1522209014:0.text: Prioritizing war over feeding people? Some governance.
say:19:1522209014:0.source_cn: 为了打仗不叫人吃饭？这治邦之道还真是有意思。

say:20:1522209015:1.text: No one thought the war would last this long...
say:20:1522209015:1.source_cn: 谁能想到战争会持续这么久……

say:21:1522209016:1.text: But the general's already taken one of the Wildborn camps. Shouldn't be long before we get our hands on their food supplies!
say:21:1522209016:1.source_cn: 不过统帅已经攻下兽人的一座营地了，应该用不了太久，就会...

choice_prompt:22:1522209016.text: But the general's already taken one of the Wildborn camps. Shouldn't be long before we get our hands on their food supplies!
choice_prompt:22:1522209016.source_cn: 不过统帅已经攻下兽人的一座营地了，应该用不了太久，就会有兽人的食物填补上城内的空缺！

say:23:1522209017:0.text: Thanks for being open. What you've told us will help the Arcane Council figure out how to ease the suffering here.
say:23:1522209017:0.source_cn: 感谢你的慷慨分享。这些信息一定能帮助魔法师协会了解呼临...

choice:22:1:2.source_cn: 那些食物可能还不够前线吃的

say:1:1522211001:0.text: Excuse me, are you the lieutenant's soldiers?
say:1:1522211001:0.source_cn: 几位大人，你们是副将大人的手下吗？

choice_prompt:2:1522211001.text: Excuse me, are you the lieutenant's soldiers?
choice_prompt:2:1522211001.source_cn: 几位大人，你们是副将大人的手下吗？

say:5:1522211003:0.text: Let me introduce us. The three of us are members of the Arcane Council. We came to Halia to meet with the Regulus.
say:5:1522211003:0.source_cn: 请容许我做自我介绍：我们三人是魔法师协会的成员，此次来...

say:6:1522211004:0.text: Mages? Meeting the Regulus? You must be someone important...
say:6:1522211004:0.source_cn: 魔法师？还能面见领主？那你们一定都是了不起的大人物……

say:7:1522211005:0.text:
Anyway... *Cough*
Could I ask a favor? Could you pass my thanks along to the lieutenant?
say:7:1522211005:0.source_cn: 总之……咳咳！\n总之能不能拜托你们，把我的谢意转达给...

choice_prompt:8:1522211005.text:
Anyway... *Cough*
Could I ask a favor? Could you pass my thanks along to the lieutenant?
choice_prompt:8:1522211005.source_cn: 总之……咳咳！\n总之能不能拜托你们，把我的谢意转达给副将大人？

say:10:1522211006:0.text: Thank him? That lieutenant nearly threw me in jail! Nim, don't fall for his act!
say:10:1522211006:0.source_cn: 谢他？那个副将差点要把我抓走！尼姆，你别被他骗了！

say:11:1522211007:1.text: *Cough* Siman, don't be like that. He was misled, that's all.
say:11:1522211007:1.source_cn: 咳咳咳……西蒙，别这样说。副将大人只是被蒙蔽了。

say:12:1522211008:0.text: You know how Jakon and his lot are. <style="highlight">Every time there's a food handout, they show up trying to grab more than their share</style>.
say:12:1522211008:0.source_cn: 你又不是不认识伊阿宋那群人……<style=highl...

say:13:1522211009:0.text: If it weren't for <style="highlight">General Perseus sending guards to keep watch</style>, we'd have starved to death long ago...
say:13:1522211009:0.source_cn: 如果不是<style=highlight>统帅大人常常...

say:15:1522211010:0.text: If you don't mind me asking, the soldiers handing out food today—were they sent by Perseus himself?
say:15:1522211010:0.source_cn: 恕我冒昧，今日发放粮食的士兵也是珀尔修斯派来的亲卫兵吗？

say:16:1522211011:1.text: During that earlier fight, their actions didn't exactly win anyone over.
say:16:1522211011:1.source_cn: 适才发生争执时，他们的作为并不能服众。

say:17:1522211012:0.text: I heard the general's been staying near the front lines. Hasn't had much time for city matters.
say:17:1522211012:0.source_cn: 统帅大人最近好像一直在前线，不怎么插手城内的事。

say:18:1522211013:0.text: If he were here, I wouldn't waste my breath arguing with that weasel...
say:18:1522211013:0.source_cn: 要不是这样，我也不想浪费力气和那个无耻的家伙吵架……

say:19:1522211014:0.text: Good thing... good thing the lieutenant showed up in person.
say:19:1522211014:0.source_cn: 幸好……幸好副将大人亲自来了。

say:20:1522211015:1.text: <style="highlight">He's Perseus' right hand. He has to stand up for us</style>. *Cough* Siman, we shouldn't doubt him.

say:21:1522211016:0.text: Look... didn't he send those people packing? Told them they couldn't take any food?
say:21:1522211016:0.source_cn: 你看……他不是把那些人赶走，不让他们领粮食了吗？

say:22:1522211017:0.text: I mean... I hope you're right.
say:22:1522211017:0.source_cn: 唉，我也不希望真是那样。

say:23:1522211018:0.text: Perseus is a good man. If he picked that lieutenant himself, maybe he's not so bad either...
say:23:1522211018:0.source_cn: 统帅那么好的人，他亲自挑选的副将应该也不是坏人吧……

choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 你没看出来他在拉偏架吗？

choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 我？他的手下？别开玩笑了！

choice:2:2:3.source_cn: 我们是呼临城的救世主！

say:1:1522212001:0.text: Papa, look! That lady has a tail!
say:1:1522212001:0.source_cn: 爸爸，你快看，那个姐姐有尾巴……！

say:5:1522212003:0.text: Jubi! Stay close... That's a Wildborn.

say:6:1522212004:0.source_cn: 一个兽人居然来到了呼临城……

say:8:1522212005:0.text: See? I knew bringing her would cause trouble.
say:8:1522212005:0.source_cn: 啊，我就知道，带着她肯定会惹来不少麻烦。

say:10:1522212006:0.text: Halia citizens, there's no need to be alarmed. This girl is—
say:10:1522212006:0.source_cn: 呼临人啊，你们无需紧张。这位少女是——

say:11:1522212007:1.source_cn: 我，我知道。我能想象得到……

say:12:1522212008:0.text: Poor thing... You must've lost your home and family in the war...
say:12:1522212008:0.source_cn: 可怜的孩子，一定是战争害你失去了家乡和亲人……

say:13:1522212009:0.text: Here. I've got some bread left. Take it.
say:13:1522212009:0.source_cn: 来，我这里还有一块面包……给你吧。

say:15:1522212011:0.text: The general won the battle. The Wildborn must be having a hard time now. No telling how many kids like you are out there...
say:15:1522212011:0.source_cn: 统帅打了胜仗，兽人的日子一定也很艰难。不知道会有多少像...

narration:17:1522212013:0.text: Gala hesitates, but the man presses the bread into her hands, then walks away with his son.
narration:17:1522212013:0.source_cn: 见加拉还在犹豫，那位父亲直接将面包塞进她手里，随后就带...

say:21:1522212015:0.text: He probably thought Gala was a war orphan.
say:21:1522212015:0.source_cn: 他大概是把加拉当成了父母双亡的战争孤儿。

say:23:1522212016:1.source_cn: 凡人的命运向来如此无奈。

say:24:1522212017:0.text: No matter who wins the war, it's always the commoners who suffer...
say:24:1522212017:0.source_cn: 无论战争输赢，受灾受难的都是平民……

choice_prompt:25:1522212017.text: No matter who wins the war, it's always the commoners who suffer...
choice_prompt:25:1522212017.source_cn: 无论战争输赢，受灾受难的都是平民……

say:26:1522212018:0.female: We've already helped plenty. Tried to talk peace, helped find a way to suppress the curse...
